newsitem.title: INDIA: Limited consumer demand hurts Indian sugar prices.
newsitem.headline: Limited consumer demand hurts Indian sugar prices.

text.p: Indian sugar prices suffered a fresh setback on Monday, falling on limited consumer interest and higher supplies, dealers said.
"Supplies were higher on increased offerings by the mill owners," one dealer said. Millers remained active sellers owing to dull demand from neighbouring states.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by 18/20 rupees to 1,205/1,235 rupees while M-30 slid by 2/10 rupees to 1,240/1,310. Sugar mill delivery however remained quiet at 1,140/1,150 rupees amid limited activity. Sentiments at the close were subdued.
